shared_question: What is the core problem that existing practices fail to solve, motivating this work?
What is the fundamental limitation of the straightforward solution to this problem?
What further limits the most closely related existing approaches?
What specific prior work or theory does this paper build directly on, and how?
Why is this approach conceptually preferable — what mechanism makes it work better than alternatives?
What specifically distinguishes this approach from the closest prior work, and what gap does that leave for this paper to fill?
What is the proposed system, and how does it work?
How was the system evaluated, and what did the evaluation show?
